notes:
Background: Crossglot Bridgeworks builds enterprise cross-lingual search for regulated verticals (legal, pharma). Primary differentiator is language-coverage & per-language tuning.

Summary from discovery:
- Customer has multi-tenant search product used by EU legal firms. Index size currently ~3M docs, expecting 10M+ in 12 months.
- Working languages: EN, FR, ES, DE, AR, RU, JA. Priority: FR/ES/AR for recall improvements.
- Current stack: hybrid ES + vector store (open-source). They do offline candidate generation with sparse + dense then run CPU-based cross-encoder rerank for final results.

Requirements / constraints:
- Latency SLO: P95 query end-to-end target 80-120ms for basic search; reranking can be async but top-K must be returned within 450ms for interactive scenarios.
- Throughput target for POC: 100 qps sustained for multimodal queries (text-only for now).
- Cost sensitivity: target <$0.003 per query (avg) across full pipeline; willing to pay for dedicated capacity if ROI on latency.
- Accuracy targets: per-language top-5 recall >= 0.85 (Spanish/French), tolerate slightly lower on low-resource languages.
- Model preferences: multilingual embedding model (sentence-transformer style) + GPU-accelerated cross-encoder for rerank; quantized options desired.
- Data controls: EU data residency, SOC2-like audit logs, SSO/SAML integration required. DPA must be signed.

Quotes / call snippets:
- "We need consistent recall across languages — not just English wins." — Head of Search
- "If we can reduce cost per query without sacrificing top-5 recall, we'll consolidate on a single provider." — CTO

Technical notes (SE):
- POC plan: ingest 500k trimmed records across 6 languages; run baseline vectors vs Redwood hosted embeddings; run rerank A/B (CPU cross-encoder vs Redwood GPU cross-encoder).
- Need quick quantization profile and throughput estimates (tokens per rerank call). Request: perf numbers for 768-d multilingual embed at 50k doc index and 1M doc index.
- Ask: prefix/KV caching behavior for repeated conversational hits; how caching interacts with multilingual tokenization.

Procurement / legal:
- Security questionnaire submitted 2025-02-10 (drive link above). Legal flagged data residency and DPA clauses. IT procurement expects vendor evaluation to finish by 2025-04.

Internal notes / next actions:
- SE (Marina) to deliver perf matrix + cost model by 2025-02-24.
- AE (Jordan) to arrange EU-dedicated trial pricing and get DPA draft to customer legal.
- POC kickoff target week of 2025-03-03.
